name: dashboard-offer-external-model-admin
title: Offer · External model
description: All configured external models. Bounded request receipts remain separate from monthly provider billing, user/team charges and invoice reconciliation.

options.text: Consumers pay the applicable **input, output, cache and tool rates**, plus disclosed fees, credits and commitments. Provider capacity is recovered through those terms; any platform commitment or retry cost needs an explicit owner. **Rates, monthly charges and invoices are not measured here yet.** A prototype/trial endpoint does not establish a production zero-price tariff. Bounded request receipts prove only those requests. User/subscription identity does not prove team membership; latency, SLOs and complete provider billing categories remain unqualified.

name: dashboard-offer-shared-private-admin
title: Offer · Shared private
description: Observed bounded Qwen usage and hosting allocation, separately from unknown monthly tariffs, customer charges and service recovery.

contract.title: Shared private · tariff and idle ownership

options.text: A shared offer uses a **prospective input/output tariff**, with any reservation fees, included-use credits and subsidy disclosed separately. The platform owns demand shortfall under the default contract. The observed Qwen tables below are a **closed, six-minute hosting allocation**, not monthly customer charges and not a dedicated service. Costs split within each window; fully idle windows stay with Platform idle. Monthly tariffs, revenue and recovery remain Unknown until a service report is selected.

reportIdentity.title: Observed bounded Qwen report · UTC
